stance_rationale: The honest TRUE-OOS FAIL conclusion is directionally correct, but the Forge package still fails validation because required schedule/return artifacts are absent or inconsistent with the backtest, Harvey 5-spec is incomplete, and DSR penalty basis is not the requested candidate-count audit.

critical_concerns.description: weights.csv and monthly_returns.parquet are absent, alpha_scores.parquet is absent at the requested stage path, and overlay_schedule.csv is not faithful to the backtest: it has 277 dates, only 139 non-NA p_bad_t rows, and all classification fields remain NORMAL_PLACEHOLDER while the package claims 220 TRUE-OOS emissions.
Harvey 5-spec is not CAPM/Carhart-3/Carhart-4/FF5/FF6; it is BM/proxy specs with spec3 null and 0/5 t_NW above 3.0, so the Harvey-Liu-Zhu gate remains failed despite the label.

DSR uses n_trials=90 while trial_results_90.parquet contains 375 raw trials, and optimizer candidates are not added; this is not the requested candidates_tried × 0.05 or total-candidate penalty audit.

Baseline comparison is same-period BM-overlay only, not full STR_1715 PG2 NAV with the same holdings, cost stack, lockbox split, and DSR penalty; Path A MDD remains -78.6%, far beyond the <45% hard hurdle.
M4 comparison is still against M4_BOCPD_or_proxy, while challenge_note_forge retains stale v1 language about strong DM evidence; v2 actually reports DM p=0.1129 and Path A worse than baseline.

p_bad_t_emission.parquet retains a future 2026-05-31 row with thresholds and beta_bear=1.0 even though p_bad_t is NA; production artifacts should filter future-labeled rows rather than encode a default signal row.

supporting_arguments: p_bad_t_emission.parquet does contain a real time series: 437 rows, 220 non-NA OOS predictions across W1-W5, so the prior single-snapshot bug is partly repaired at the p_bad_t level.
covariance.parquet passes the requested PSD/condition check: 13x13 numeric matrix, min eigenvalue positive, condition number about 76.47 <= 100.
equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png exist; the equity and OOS charts show Path A after the 2023-12-31 lockbox marker.
Turnover cost code uses 0.0015 × 2 × abs(delta beta), so RF-F7 is not the binding issue.
The package’s own production_grade=false and TRUE-OOS FAIL verdict are supported by SR_A 0.139 vs SR_C 0.176, unchanged MDD, Harvey 0/5, and DSR_A -3.5882.
unresolved_disputes: Whether overlay_schedule.csv can replace role-prompt weights.csv without a formally approved Forge overlay schema.
Whether bt_result.rds can replace the required monthly_returns.parquet artifact for audit reproducibility.
Whether DSR should use 90 effective trials, 375 raw Forge trials, or 375 plus optimizer candidate count.
Whether realized_vol_60d proxy is acceptable for M4 DM testing when the package discusses M4 admission/replacement.
Whether BM-overlay evidence is sufficient for any Layer 6 admission before full STR_1715 PG2 NAV integration.
weakest_assumption: A placeholder-heavy overlay_schedule and missing official weights/monthly_returns artifacts can be treated as sufficient walk-forward execution evidence because the narrative now admits TRUE-OOS failure.
rebuttal_required: Emit weights.csv or a formally approved overlay schedule with every OOS p_bad_t date, non-placeholder classifications, beta state transitions, and exact alignment to the backtest returns.
Emit monthly_returns.parquet with Path A/B/C gross/net returns, costs, beta_lag, and Date range used in metrics.
Run proper CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 regressions with non-null alpha/t_NW, or rename the current artifact as proxy-only and fail RF-F6 explicitly.
Recompute DSR using the agreed total candidate count and apply the same basis to Path A/B/C baseline comparisons.
Replace M4 proxy with production M4 BOCPD signal, or downgrade all M4 incrementality claims to exploratory proxy evidence.
Before admission, run full STR_1715 PG2 NAV × beta_bear integration with same-period, same-cost, same-lockbox baseline.
rationalization_red_flags: Production deployment expected SR materially higher post architect integration
Full sleeve power expected materially higher
DM t=-4.92 p=4.35e-7 strong signal is proxy-noise robust
KR FF3/FF5/Carhart factor data 부재 -> BM-only proxy

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: I agree with the final fail direction, but not with treating the Forge package as validation-complete; RF-F2, RF-F5, RF-F6, and full-strategy baseline evidence remain unresolved.
